name: Rjukan-Notodden Industrial Heritage Site
description: In Telemark, southern Norway, this chain of power stations, factories, railways and company towns turned waterfalls into fertilizer. Norsk Hydro built it in the early 1900s to pull nitrogen from the air for crops, using the Birkeland–Eyde process. Walk through Rjukan and Notodden, and you can still see the workers' housing and social buildings, set among steep mountains and river valleys.
